faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Hyderabad Research Associate-I Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the Research Associate-I post at IIT Hyderabad is 05 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Research Associate-I at IIT Hyderabad?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Research Associate-I post in the current recruitment drive by IIT Hyderabad.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for IIT Hyderabad Research Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for the Research Associate-I position at IIT Hyderabad.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Research Associate-I post at IIT Hyderabad?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Research Associate-I position will receive a salary of Rs. 58000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for Research Associate-I?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Research Associate-I post is 35 years, with relaxations as per government norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required qualification for Research Associate-I?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Ph.D. in Materials Science and Metallurgical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related field.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for Research Associate-I at IIT Hyderabad?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting based on academic records and experience, followed by an online interview.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the IIT Hyderabad Research Associate-I position?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official IIT Hyderabad website by following the instructions provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q9. When was the notification for IIT Hyderabad Research Associate-I released?
faq.answer: The official notification for the Research Associate-I recruitment was released on 12 August 2026.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for the Research Associate-I post?
faq.answer: The Research Associate-I position at IIT Hyderabad is a Contractual job type.
